subject: GROK-HD-SB-WRITER-batch02 amended v002 placed (DJB Chewy, co-pilot W08)
body:
Batch02 amended pass is placed at D:\Documents\CFA\docs\notes\downloads\GROK-HD-SB-WRITER-batch02\ with v002 of W05 to W09 and the amended NOTES. Earlier files were renamed -v001 (not deleted). W07 to W09 v001 are marked -v001-EXPLORATORY: they used an invented Chewy and must not be used for identity.

Chewy v002 uses the DJ beast sheet (DJB-01, hash ca406436d384, matches D:). W08 is now Chewy in the co-pilot seat, flipping switches and looking toward the pilot seat. W05 and W06 put the DJ station left of the pilot seat, around the bend in a roomier lounge bay.

GAP: CHEW-STAGE-01 and CHEW-STYLE-01 were not accessible, so styling came only from the DJB sheet. Drafts only, no timestamps. Hashes of the new files are in the attachments.
